audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and 2-item phase text claimed Heartsteel is your spike and that 'your side-lane pattern is at full power' at two items. In this specific matchup those are Nasus's phases, not yours.
audit.why: Nasus's Sheen timing turns a stacked Siphoning Strike (7.5s at rank 1, 3.5s at rank 5, reduced again inside his ultimate) into a real chunk, and Fury of the Sands is 120/100/80s with bonus health that lifts him back above Feast's execute threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability interactions were absent, and one stated interaction is wrong. The absent ones: Fury of the Sands deals percent-maximum-health damage, so every Feast stack Cho'Gath banks makes Nasus's ultimate hit him harder; and Spirit Fire (12s flat) reduces armour, which is aimed directly at a Grasp/Heartsteel Cho'Gath. The wrong one: 'W-silence his Wither' and 'Silence it before all-in' — a silence stops a cast, it does not shorten a Wither already applied.
audit.why: Feast is Cho'Gath's whole scaling plan and Fury of the Sands is the one ability in Nasus's kit that scales with the exact stat Feast grants. Nasus's Q is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up on his auto is the trade tell, not the Q cast.
audit.corrected: percent-health interaction written into phases[6].why; Spirit Fire's armour shred into phases[3].why; the silence claim corrected in report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns to 'fight in Wither's downtime' rather than 'silence it off'.

notes: Reused the mechanical findings from the already-audited mirror (audits/top/nasus__chogath.json) rather than re-deriving them, and kept the level chart identical to it. Two things I deliberately did NOT assert, both carried over from the mirror's open question: whether Feral Scream's silence, landing after Siphoning Strike is cast but before the empowered auto connects, cancels that auto or leaves it armed — needsResearch.animationCancels is null for both champions and Riot's text does not cover it; and whether Wither is reduced by tenacity. dosFull[2].t currently reads 'W-silence his Wither', which is mechanically wrong for an already-applied Wither, but the string is 20 characters and apply-proposals.js skips anything under 25, so I could not correct it through a proposal — it needs a manual fix or a one-off script. Same class of problem in loading text: 'Engage only on Wither's cooldown' is fine, but the focus.text 'Nasus Wither' is fine too. Cho'Gath's kit file flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's description says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote it as a knockup and claimed no grounding effect.
